title: AuthoritativeSource
description: Monitored listing page, API, feed or document source. See docs/data/INDIA_CI_TARIFF_DATA_STRATEGY.md section 4 and 5.1.

regulator_code.description: Code from regulators.yaml, if this source is regulator-owned.

licensee_code.description: Code from licensees.yaml, if this source is licensee-owned.

url.description: Listing URL to discover documents from.

authority_rank.description: Position in the authoritative source hierarchy (section 4): 1=commission tariff order, 6=secondary summary.

allowed_domains.description: Hostnames the fetcher may contact for this source. Redirects outside this list must be refused (crawler architecture section 5.3, 8).

adapter.description: Name of the discovery adapter implementation, e.g. generic_regulator_listing.

include_patterns.description: Substrings/keywords a discovered link's URL or text must contain to be a candidate document.

exclude_patterns.description: Substrings/keywords that disqualify an otherwise-matching link (e.g. petition, public-hearing).

last_verified.description: Date a human last confirmed this source configuration still matches the live site.
